name: Identity & Access API
description: Authenticates callers and checks entitlements — the standard identity lookup every internal service is expected to call.

name: Document Repository API
description: Stores and retrieves versioned documents, used as the backing store behind document-heavy and retrieval workflows.

name: Notification API
description: Sends email, SMS, and push notifications from any internal workflow.

name: Payments API
description: Initiates and checks the status of payment transactions against the enterprise payment processor.
